# Lab 12.27: Restrict Service Usage with Org Policy

## What We Are Going to Do
Block a Google Cloud service in a project with the `gcp.restrictServiceUsage` constraint and see what users experience.

## Steps

1. **Check the service works first.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:svc_test
bq rm -f --dataset $PROJECT_ID:svc_test</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Deny BigQuery in this project.** Create `restrict.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/policies/gcp.restrictServiceUsage
spec:
  rules:
  - values:
      deniedValues:
      - bigquery.googleapis.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud org-policies set-policy restrict.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Test it.** After a few minutes:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:svc_test</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It fails with a policy error.

4. **See the policy in the console.** Go to **IAM & Admin → Organization policies** and search **Restrict Resource Service Usage**. It shows **Customized** for this project.

5. **Compare with related constraints.**
   - `gcp.restrictServiceUsage`: which services can be used at all
   - `gcp.restrictNonCmekServices`: which services must use CMEK
   - `gcp.resourceLocations`: where resources can be created
   - VPC Service Controls: stops data leaving through allowed services

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud org-policies delete gcp.restrictServiceUsage --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| BigQuery in this project | Blocked |
| Other services | Not affected |
| Supported services | Only those listed for this constraint |
| Typical use | Allow-list approved services at org or folder level |
